applies_to.selection: route native_session_file; experimental combined-source evidence only

executor: journal-ocsf-writer ClaudeTranscriptMapper (direct Java); one record at a time; state: artifact time fallback only
admission: COMPLETE: every record of the file is mapped or retained whole; there is no response filter and no declared exclusion. Families without a normalization rule are retained whole with their disposition stated in sources[].family_inventory.

time_policy.reported: timestamp on user, assistant, attachment, queue-operation, api-request and api-request-shape records
time_policy.fallback: latest preceding reported time in this artifact (atis-latch, api-request-blob, last-prompt, cost-state carry none)

tool_kind_table.note: Name table only. The kind describes the request; no OS effect is asserted.

rules.activity: 2 Completed when message.stop_reason is non-null, else 1 Partial (rule claude.transcript.activity.v1)
rules.owner: response_uid = message.id (every message id, not one admitted response)
rules.usage: message.usage -> scope 2 Model response, status 2 Final when stop_reason non-null (rule claude.transcript.usage_status.v1); the transcript repeats the message's usage on every block record, so one response yields several equal Final observations that the view counts once; aggregation 1 Scope total (anthropic.usage.per_message.v1); canonical tranches (anthropic.usage.tranches.v1, prompt-caching definitions: input_tokens are the tokens neither read from nor used to create a cache): uncached_input_tokens = input_tokens, cache_read_tokens = cache_read_input_tokens, cache_write_tokens = cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_write_tiers = the cache_creation members (parts of cache_creation_input_tokens), output_tokens, reasoning_tokens = output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens with reasoning_relation 1 Part of output (anthropic.usage.thinking_in_output.v1); every component Reported in components[] with its RFC 6901 pointer; absent members stay absent

selector.content: no tool_result block (bare string or blocks)

rules.status: status_id 1/2 from block.is_error when boolean (Reported); 0 Unknown with basis 3 when absent or null
rules.permission: permissionDecision (record level; only when the record carries exactly one tool_result) -> scope 1 Tool call, attribution 1 Unique, method 1 Reported identifier
rules.residual: toolUseResult in structured_result; whole record in data of the first result event

rules.fields: context_kind = attachment/<attachment.type>; rendered_role = renderedRole; content_blocks = rendered[] as Text blocks when present
rules.residual: whole record in data (the attachment object itself: environment snapshot, model identity, tool/agent/skill listings, instructions files, session context, date, credential org, remote session change, prompt snapshot, deferred tools)

rules.usage: modelUsage[m] -> usage_observation scope 5 Session status 2 Final (rule claude.transcript.cost_state.v1: cumulative per-model session usage written after the turn); canonical tranches from Claude Code ModelUsage: uncached_input_tokens = inputTokens, cache_read_tokens = cacheReadInputTokens, cache_write_tokens = cacheCreationInputTokens, output_tokens = outputTokens, reasoning_tokens = thinkingTokens with reasoning_relation 1 Part of output (claude.model_usage.thinking_in_output.v1: documented as already counted inside outputTokens); aggregation 2 Cumulative snapshot (claude.model_usage.cumulative.v1)
rules.cost: totalCostUSD -> cost_observation total_cost, currency USD, scope 5 Session
rules.residual: whole record in data (durations, lines added/removed, hasUnknownModelCost)

rules.selector: queue-operation, atis-latch, api-request-shape, api-request-blob, api-request, last-prompt and any unknown type
rules.residual: whole record in data; basis states the known meaning or that it is unresolved

rules.selector: any line that is blank, not UTF-8, not one JSON object under strict duplicate-key parsing, or cut off by the end of the source
rules.residual: raw_data (text) or raw_bytes_b64 (bytes); parse_status_id 5 Incomplete at source end when the source ended mid-record

rules.selector: a parsed record whose mapper threw
rules.residual: whole record in data; basis names the exception. A defect of the writer is visible, never a lost record

rules.fields: shape.tools -> tool_definitions, with exact names, descriptions and input_schema documents. No tool invocation or protocol negotiation follows.

retained_only_families.queue-operation: prompt queue enqueue/dequeue; content is a repeat of the user prompt
retained_only_families.api-request-shape: system prompt and tool definitions sent to the API (what the model saw, request side)
retained_only_families.api-request-blob: API request message arrays: repeat representations of records already normalized (prompt, attachments, assistant blocks, tool results); not counted as submissions or responses
retained_only_families.api-request: request bookkeeping: model, betas, cache control, digests, request chain (base/keep/tail)
